prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed so far.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Path Overview: Redesign the story screen into a story scroll layout showcasing pet paths before selection. (why: The choose_path step has a median time of 8s and high mean time of 514s, indicating path confusion before commitment.)
1: [sign_in, incentive] Sign In Pet Perks Banner: Display a account perk badge on the sign-in screen highlighting cross-desktop cloud saving. (why: 8 support tickets cited pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in drops 27.1% of users.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Mood Preview Screen: Insert a dedicated companion mood preview screen right after pick_friend to show animated pet behaviors. (why: Adoption step conversion is low (66.2%) with median time of 89s and reported custom pet generation issues.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Initialization Carousel: Add an interactive tip carousel and estimated time indicator to the waiting screen. (why: The waiting phase has high dropoff and extreme duration (median 201s, mean 2336s).)
4: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Grid Selection Layout: Transform the pick_friend layout into a structured grid format with visual pet choice cards. (why: Adoption drops over 33% of users and takes 89s median time.)
5: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Connection Timeout Notice: Show an automatic readiness status notification on the sign-in screen to inform users if sign-in stalls. (why: Support received reports that the sign-in screen stalls or fails to load properly.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Step Counter: Display explicit step counters and a time estimate on choose_path to set quick completion expectations. (why: Choose path drops nearly 24% of users with high average completion time.)
7: [finish, hint] Taskbar Docking System Hint: Add an explicit taskbar badge and hint explaining where the pet docks on the desktop screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing up on desktop or app refusing to open after setup.)

scores.note: UI redesign for choose_path requires full release; evidence comes only from funnel timing.
Addresses 27.1% sign-in drop and 8 support tickets with simple banner config.
Adding new screen has high cost and adoption redesigns show weak historical lift.
Targets extreme delay at home step (median 201s, mean 2336s) with interactive wait UI.
Adoption loses 33.8% of users, but redesign evidence remains thin (+2.0% historical).
Directly resolves sign-in stall support reports and high step dropoff via quick status UI.
Low-cost copy addition setting time expectations for choose_path step.
Finish step drops 35.2% and support notes desktop missing pet issues; simple hint fix.
